genotype_to_drug_rule: Calls R if the mapped drug token appears in StarAMR summary.tsv Predicted Phenotype (combining ResFinder and --pointfinder-organism where supported); calls no_call when Quality Module fails with no resistance hit; otherwise S.

i_handling.description: StarAMR summary.tsv emits resistance tokens or Sensitive without I; any I token is counted separately and never mapped to S.
